aboutGame.title: What is Icycle On Thin Ice?
paragraphs: Icycle On Thin Ice is an award-winning surreal physics platformer developed by Damp Gnat. Players guide Dennis, an eccentric cyclist clad only in wool socks, as he pedals an undersized bicycle across a frozen, post-apocalyptic Earth in search of lost love.

Traverse over 27 stunning, collapsible locations and psychedelic dream sequences filled with deadly icicles, shifting terrain, and hidden secrets. Equip umbrellas for gliding, unlock powerful vacuum cleaners to harvest ice chips, and tackle 80 inventive missions across this cult classic adventure.

items.question: What is Icycle On Thin Ice?
items.answer: Icycle On Thin Ice is an indie physics platformer created by Damp Gnat. Players navigate the surreal journey of Dennis, riding a small bicycle across frozen dreamscapes and collapsing hazards while searching for love in an icy apocalypse.

items.question: How do movement and jump physics work in Icycle On Thin Ice?
items.answer: In Icycle On Thin Ice, Dennis rides a bicycle governed by momentum and surface friction. Pedaling builds rotational velocity, while jumping and feathering the umbrella canopy lets you catch updrafts, glide over chasms, and control delicate landings on slippery terrain.

items.question: What are the best early upgrades to buy in Icycle On Thin Ice?
items.answer: In the Icebox shop of Icycle On Thin Ice, you should prioritize purchasing the Canister Vacuum and upgraded umbrella gliders before cosmetic clothing. Vacuums automatically pull in distant ice chips, drastically boosting your currency reserves for late-game stages.

items.question: How many levels and secret missions are in Icycle On Thin Ice?
items.answer: Icycle On Thin Ice features 27 main campaign locations, 5 surreal bonus dream sequences, 5 hidden chambers, and 80 challenging mission objectives that reward unique wardrobe unlocks and scrapbook snapshots.

items.question: Where can I play Icycle On Thin Ice?
items.answer: Icycle On Thin Ice is available on Steam for PC with full controller support and bundled with the original classic browser game, as well as on mobile platforms like iOS.
